B0DY21V8MG.title: First Alert 10-Year Battery Combination Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Alarm
bullets: First Alert's Precision Detection advanced sensing technology complies with the latest industry standards to reduce cooking nuisance alarms and provides early warning in the event of a home fire emergency. Provides reliable 2-in-1 detection against both smoke and carbon monoxide.
Requires Ring Alarm Base Station to provide notifications while away in the event of a fire or CO emergency. Ring Alarm or Ring Alarm Pro Security Kit with Alarm Smoke and CO Listener required.
10-Year sealed battery eliminates battery replacements and low battery chirps
End-of-life warning lets you know when it’s time to replace the alarm. Test/silence button for efficient testing to ensure alarm is working properly.
The date shown on the product is the Manufacture Date, which identifies when the product was produced

specs.Item Highlight: SMCO410, Works with Ring Alarm Base Station

B0C7HVF4SJ.title: Zooz 800 Series Z-Wave Long Range DC Signal Sensor ZEN55 | for Use with Analog Smoke & CO Detectors Only | Z-Wave Hub Required (Sold Separately)
bullets: ADD Z-WAVE TO SMOKE AND CO ALARMS: Wire the DC Signal Sensor to your interconnected smoke and CO detectors and receive deticated notifications if either of them is triggered. NOTE: This is NOT a security alarm component and the device is NOT part of a life-safety system. Check local regulations before installing. Check Z-Wave compatibility first, this is an advanced device supported by selected hubs only (scroll down for details).

OPTIONAL RELAY CONTROL: Utilize the 120 V relay to add smart control of lights or siren as additional functionality. Do NOT use for other low-Voltage applications. This device comes with SmartStart for quick and secure network inclusion.

LONG RANGE READY: If your hub and automation software support Z-Wave Long Range, you'll get extended coverage without network lags and dropouts! And for traditional set-ups, the built-in signal repeater keeps your mesh networks stable and fast.

EASY INSTALLATION: Pigtail wires included to save you time when wiring the dimmer for an hassle-free set-up. This product is backed by a lifetime US based support from Zooz and a 5-year warranty once registered.

HUB COMPATIBILITY: This is an advanced Z-Wave device and it requires an updated Z-Wave hub to display correctly. It was tested to work well with the Z-Box Hub (recommended for Zooz devices), Hubitat with custom driver, Home Assistant (Z-Wave JS), Ezlo, and it's compatible with SmartThings through a custom edge driver (available through the Zooz support portal).
